.._comment_release_type: `rust`, not `simple`. `simple` has no updater that can reach Cargo.lock, so every release left the lock naming the PREVIOUS version while Cargo.toml named the new one: `cargo --locked` failed on main and nothing in CI enforced it, so it went unnoticed. The same config in brain-sdk surfaced as a failed crates.io publish, where `cargo publish` re-resolved the lock, found the tree dirty and refused. `rust` updates the workspace manifest and Cargo.lock together, which is what brain-edge already does. No `extra-files` entry for Cargo.toml: the rust strategy owns it.
